description: This file implements SambaNova's Speech-to-Text (STT) service as a subclass of a base STT service, providing real-time transcription capability via SambaNova's Whisper API. It defines the SambaNovaSTTService class with initialization and transcription methods, managing API interactions and parameters.

classes.name: SambaNovaSTTService
classes.description: A speech-to-text service utilizing SambaNova's Whisper API, capable of converting audio bytes into transcriptions and configured with models, API key, URL, language, prompt, and temperature settings.

methods.name: None __init__( self, *, model: str = "Whisper-Large-v3", api_key: Optional[str] = None, base_url: str = "https://api.sambanova.ai/v1", language: Optional[Language] = Language.EN, prompt: Optional[str] = None, temperature: Optional[float] = None, **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Initializes the SambaNovaSTTService with model parameters, API key, URL, language, prompt, and temperature settings, calling the base class constructor.

methods.name: Transcription _transcribe(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the provided audio bytes to obtain a transcription using SambaNova's API, including mappings for optional parameters like prompt and temperature, and logging a warning if probability metrics are requested.
